::: {#lem-rss-deriv-intercept}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the intercept

The partial derivative of the simple linear regression
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the intercept is

$$\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef}
= -2 \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
= -2 \paren{n \bar{y} - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \bar{x}}.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-rss-deriv-intercept.

:::
